name: primitives-texts-gradient
title: Gradient Text
description: Two lines of bold display text with a looping blue, purple and pink gradient; the second line repeats itself as a soft blurred glow.
use: A hero or section headline should feel alive without a moving background.
avoid: The gradient is hardcoded, and the pale blues and glows would lose contrast on a light page.
a11y: It animates forever and never checks prefers-reduced-motion, so the gradient keeps drifting for motion-sensitive readers. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two lines of large sans-serif text on black: a bold headline across the top and a slightly smaller line below. The letters carry a blue, purple and pink gradient, and the lower line has a soft glowing halo.
behaves: The gradient scrolls sideways through the letters in an endless slow loop, so the colours drift from blue to pink and back. The lower line's blurred copy brightens in step.
customise: Pass the text string, choose a gradient string and turn the neon glow on or off; the scroll distance and looping transition are props too.
weight: light: Two text spans with a looping background position; no layout cost.
